_readme: Central affiliate link registry for growingmj.com. Each key is an affiliate ID referenced in article HTML as href="[[AFFILIATE:<id>]]" (or, once stamped, as the finished URL). Run scripts/apply_affiliate_links.py to stamp every placeholder across the whole site in one pass. See README.md for full instructions.
_link_policy: Every URL below is an Amazon CATEGORY SEARCH, not a product page. A search result set has no fixed contents, so the article copy attached to these links must only assert what a category can support -- selection criteria, what the tool measures, what it cannot do -- and must never assert a fact about a specific product (its composition, its specs, its price, its brand history). The 'criteria' field on each entry is the shopping instruction the copy is allowed to give. If a specific ASIN is ever added for an entry, replace 'url' with that product URL, add an 'asin' field, and the product-specific claims may come back attached to it -- verified against that listing.

grow-tent-2x2.label: 2x2 ft grow tent
grow-tent-2x2.criteria: Metal poles rather than plastic connectors, 600D or heavier fabric, and vent ports sized for the fan you plan to use.

grow-tent-4x4.label: 4x4 ft grow tent
grow-tent-4x4.criteria: Alloy steel poles and thick canvas rated to carry a light and a fan without sagging; check the port diameter against your fan's duct size.

led-grow-light-quantum.label: full-spectrum LED grow light for a 4x4 footprint
led-grow-light-quantum.criteria: A bar-style layout rather than one dense panel, a published PPFD map for the footprint you are covering, and a dimmer.

grow-light-timer.label: 7-day digital outlet timer
grow-light-timer.criteria: Battery backup so a power blip does not silently shift the schedule, and a wattage rating at or above your fixture's draw.

hydroponic-kit-dwc.label: complete hydroponic system kit
hydroponic-kit-dwc.criteria: Reservoir, growing chamber and air pump in one box, with replacement parts still sold separately.

ph-meter.label: digital pH meter
ph-meter.criteria: A replaceable probe, two-point calibration, and calibration solution included or cheaply available.

ppm-ec-meter.label: EC/TDS meter
ppm-ec-meter.criteria: Automatic temperature compensation, and a stated conversion factor if it reports PPM rather than raw EC.

air-pump-stone.label: dual-outlet air pump and air stone
air-pump-stone.criteria: Two outlets so one pump runs two buckets or a spare stone, and airline tubing included.

indoor-herb-garden-kit.label: countertop hydroponic herb garden
indoor-herb-garden-kit.criteria: Check whether it accepts your own seeds and plain nutrient solution or only the maker's refill pods.

seed-starting-tray.label: seedling heat mat, tray and humidity dome kit
seed-starting-tray.criteria: A vented dome, a tray without holes for bottom watering, and a mat sized to the tray.

hygrometer-thermometer.label: digital thermometer/hygrometer
hygrometer-thermometer.criteria: A remote probe or a small enough body to sit at canopy height, and a min/max memory.

inline-fan-carbon-filter.label: inline fan and carbon filter kit
inline-fan-carbon-filter.criteria: A speed controller, a published noise figure at the CFM you need, and a duct diameter matching your tent's ports.

soil-moisture-meter.label: capacitive soil moisture meter
soil-moisture-meter.criteria: Must say capacitive or dielectric. The cheap two-prong analog dials that need no battery read electrical conductivity, so fertilizer salts push them toward 'wet' regardless of actual water content.

self-watering-planter.label: self-watering planter
self-watering-planter.criteria: A visible water-level window or float, and an overflow so a heavy watering cannot drown the reservoir.

potting-mix-general.label: indoor potting mix
potting-mix-general.criteria: Read the ingredient panel: a peat or coir base with perlite already blended in, and no garden soil or topsoil listed.

coco-coir-growing-medium.label: coco coir brick
coco-coir-growing-medium.criteria: A blend of fiber and chips rather than straight fiber, and a note that it has been buffered or rinsed.

clip-fan-grow-tent.label: 6-inch clip fan
clip-fan-grow-tent.criteria: A clamp that grips a tent pole, and a low speed that is genuinely low.

pruning-snips.label: micro-tip pruning snips
pruning-snips.criteria: Bypass blades rather than anvil, spring-action handles, and tips narrow enough to reach into a crowded pot.

neem-oil-spray.label: cold-pressed neem oil concentrate
neem-oil-spray.criteria: Cold-pressed rather than clarified hydrophobic extract, and a label that gives a dilution rate for edible plants.

yellow-sticky-traps.label: dual-sided yellow sticky traps
yellow-sticky-traps.criteria: Adhesive on both faces, and stakes short enough to sit in a houseplant pot.

insecticidal-soap.label: insecticidal soap
insecticidal-soap.criteria: Ready-to-use if you have a few plants, concentrate if you have many; either way check the label lists edibles.

general-purpose-fertilizer.label: complete liquid fertilizer
general-purpose-fertilizer.criteria: The guaranteed analysis should list the micronutrients, not just N-P-K, and give the nitrogen sources so you can see how much of it is urea.

cal-mag-supplement.label: cal-mag supplement
cal-mag-supplement.criteria: Calcium and magnesium both stated as a percentage, and a dilution rate given per gallon.

ducting-and-clamps.label: insulated ducting with clamps
ducting-and-clamps.criteria: Clamps included, and a diameter matching both the fan and the tent's ports.

indoor-vegetable-seed-kit.label: multi-variety vegetable seed collection
indoor-vegetable-seed-kit.criteria: A packed-for date within the current year, and the packet marked open-pollinated if you intend to save seed.

seed-starting-mix.label: seed starting mix
seed-starting-mix.criteria: Fine, milled texture with no visible bark, and sold as a starting mix rather than a potting mix.

seedling-grow-light.label: seedling grow light stand
seedling-grow-light.criteria: Adjustable height in fixed steps you can change in seconds, and a footprint matching a 1020 tray.

windowsill-grow-light.label: LED grow light bar for a shelf or windowsill
windowsill-grow-light.criteria: Sized to the shelf rather than to a tent: a 2 ft bar drawing tens of watts, a dimmer, and a mount that clips or sticks to the shelf above.

rockwool-starter-cubes.label: rockwool starter cubes
rockwool-starter-cubes.criteria: Consistent cube dimensions in the sheet, and a stated density; pre-soak whatever you buy, since rockwool runs alkaline out of the bag.

perlite.label: horticultural perlite
perlite.criteria: 100% perlite with no fertilizer added, coarse grade, and an OMRI listing if you are growing food.

rooting-gel.label: rooting gel
rooting-gel.criteria: A gel rather than a powder, with the auxin concentration printed on the label.

trellis-netting.label: trellis netting
trellis-netting.criteria: Square mesh around 6 inches, and a width matching your tent or shelf.

soft-plant-ties.label: hook-and-loop plant ties
soft-plant-ties.criteria: Sold as a roll you cut to length, and soft enough not to bite into a thickening stem.

herb-drying-rack.label: hanging mesh drying rack
herb-drying-rack.criteria: Zippered sides for access, a collapsible frame, and a layer count matched to what you actually harvest.

microgreens-seed-assortment.label: microgreens seed assortment
microgreens-seed-assortment.criteria: Sold by the ounce or pound and labelled for sprouting or microgreens, with a packed-for date.

growing-trays-1020.label: 1020 growing trays
growing-trays-1020.criteria: Heavier-gauge plastic than the dollar-store kind, and a matched pair: one with drainage holes, one without.

drip-irrigation-kit.label: container drip irrigation kit
drip-irrigation-kit.criteria: Quarter-inch tubing with adjustable drippers; check whether a timer is in the box or assumed.

watering-stakes.label: ceramic self-watering stakes
watering-stakes.criteria: Unglazed porous ceramic with tubing included, and replacement tubing sold separately.

smart-plug-wifi.label: wifi smart plug
smart-plug-wifi.criteria: A wattage rating above your fixture's draw, and a schedule that keeps running when the network is down.

small-humidifier.label: small ultrasonic humidifier
small-humidifier.criteria: Cool mist, a tank you can refill from a tap without inverting it, and no auto-off that fires before the shelf is done.
